subject: conditionalPanel fails test on output variable problem

messages.author: 5c6755f9a8ddffe7
messages.subject: conditionalPanel fails test on output variable problem
parts:
Hello,

I am using a conditionalPanel that is displayed based on the value of an output variable taking TRUE or FALSE. However, the panel is not displayed unless the value of output gets rendered before. This is a minimal example:

Am I doing something wrong?

Any comments and suggestions are welcome.

All the best,
Diego

## server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, clientData) {
output$test = reactive({
TRUE
})
})

## ui.R
## This works
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
headerPanel("foo"),
sidebarPanel(
textOutput("test"),
conditionalPanel(
condition = "output.test == true",
helpText("Why is this hapenning?")
)
),
mainPanel()
)
)

## This does not work (textOutput is gone->helpText is not displayed)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
headerPanel("foo"),
sidebarPanel(
conditionalPanel(
condition = "output.test == true",
helpText("Why is this hapenning?")
)
),
mainPanel()
)
)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: conditionalPanel fails test on output variable problem
parts:
Hi Diego, by default Shiny will not calculate outputs that are not visible on the page (whether completely missing or just temporarily hidden, like in a tabPanel or conditionalPanel).

You can force Shiny to ignore the visibility and just run it by using the outputOptions function:

outputOptions(output, "test", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)
